title: Greg Cosell's 2026 NFL Week 8 PREVIEW Part 1
transcript_summary: Ross Tucker and Greg Cosell conduct their Thursday film breakdown previewing key Week matchups including Panthers-Packers, Ravens-Bills, Titans-Bengals, Cardinals-Cowboys, Vikings-Lions, and Colts-Jaguars. In the closing segment, Ross and Producer Jack discuss league news including roster moves and injury updates in Tuck's Takes.

speaker_segments.speaker: Greg Cosell
speaker_segments.text: I really like the way they play offense in the pass game. They have tremendous spacing of their route concepts, that gives Lawrence clean defined reads.

speaker_segments.speaker: Ross Tucker
speaker_segments.text: Welcome into the Ross Tucker Football Podcast, it is a teaching tutorial Thursday with Professor Greg Cosell previewing every single game.

speaker_segments.speaker: Ross Tucker
speaker_segments.text: Let me start with tonight's game, two teams coming off losses, Green Bay Packers hosting Carolina Panthers.

speaker_segments.speaker: Greg Cosell
speaker_segments.text: To me, the Packers are a good football team. Offensively now that Jacobs is back, the run game becomes critical. Their 3 wide receiver group with Golden, Watson, and Sam Williams.

speaker_segments.speaker: Ross Tucker
speaker_segments.text: You're right about Savion Williams and Christian Watson, those second year receivers give them great production.

speaker_segments.speaker: Greg Cosell
speaker_segments.text: Jordan Love is a very aggressive thrower of the football. Occasionally he'll throw a pick, but he turns it loose and makes NFL throws.

speaker_segments.speaker: Ross Tucker
speaker_segments.text: They will try to run it after what the Bucs did to the Panthers, giving up 250 yards rushing.

speaker_segments.speaker: Greg Cosell
speaker_segments.text: Jacobs had 11 carries in his first game back, but now they'll work toward him being the foundation back.

speaker_segments.speaker: Greg Cosell
speaker_segments.text: James Cook has the most first down rushes and most first down yards of any running back in the league. Their offense runs through Cook.

speaker_segments.speaker: Ross Tucker
speaker_segments.text: They're number one in yards per attempt on first down when they do throw it because teams gear up for the run.

speaker_segments.speaker: Greg Cosell
speaker_segments.text: The Ravens defense has a high stunt percentage and changes the picture pre-snap to post-snap under Jesse Minter.

speaker_segments.speaker: Ross Tucker
speaker_segments.text: The Bills don't play offense like the Bengals. Let's move on to Titans at Bengals.

speaker_segments.speaker: Greg Cosell
speaker_segments.text: Joe Burrow is going to attack the corners Flott and Joshua Williams outside the numbers with Chase and Higgins.

speaker_segments.speaker: Ross Tucker
speaker_segments.text: Titans couldn't rush the quarterback with their down four last week, and Jeffery Simmons wasn't much of a factor.

speaker_segments.speaker: Greg Cosell
speaker_segments.text: The Cowboys run game efficiency on first down dictates Dak Prescott's dropbacks.

speaker_segments.speaker: Ross Tucker
speaker_segments.text: Let's check out the Vikings at Lions matchup.

speaker_segments.speaker: Greg Cosell
speaker_segments.text: Brian Flores rushes 5 or more on 70% of dropbacks. Defenses attack A and B gaps to stop under-center play action.

speaker_segments.speaker: Ross Tucker
speaker_segments.text: That forces protection adjustments. Let's talk Colts at Jaguars.

speaker_segments.speaker: Producer Jack
speaker_segments.text: Welcome to Tuck's Takes. Some news around the league to start with.

speaker_segments.speaker: Ross Tucker
speaker_segments.text: Discussing Chiefs practice squad kicker Justin Tucker and Josh Downs trade request in Indianapolis.

speaker_segments.speaker: Producer Jack
speaker_segments.text: Injury front: Jaylen Noel out with season-ending surgery, Derwin James hamstring setback, Kirby Joseph practice window open.

speaker_segments.speaker: Ross Tucker
speaker_segments.text: Looking forward to tomorrow's show with Greg. Make sure to subscribe on YouTube or your favorite podcast app.

analysis_notes.summary: Greg Cosell notes Green Bay operates heavily out of 11 personnel (3 WRs) with Christian Watson, Savion Williams, and Jayden Reed, making the run game with Josh Jacobs vital given offensive line issues.
analysis_notes.speaker: Greg Cosell
analysis_notes.quote: They like to play out of 11 personnel, 3 wide receivers, that's the way they do most of their work.

analysis_notes.summary: Love is described as a highly aggressive passer who takes downfield risks and turns the ball loose, creating high-level NFL throws alongside occasional turnovers.
analysis_notes.speaker: Greg Cosell
analysis_notes.quote: Love is a very aggressive thrower of the football. Every once in a while he'll throw one up and it looks reckless... but he turns it loose and makes the kinds of throws demanded in the NFL.

analysis_notes.summary: James Cook leads the NFL in first-down rushes and first-down rushing yards, serving as the foundational driver of Buffalo's offense using outside zone and duo schemes.
analysis_notes.speaker: Greg Cosell
analysis_notes.quote: James Cook has the most first down rushes and the most first down yards of any running back in the league.

analysis_notes.topic: Ravens Defensive Scheme vs Josh Allen
analysis_notes.summary: Ravens DC Jesse Minter relies on heavy stunt percentages and pre-to-post snap picture changes to confuse QBs who rely on movement when clear reads aren't visible.
analysis_notes.speaker: Greg Cosell
analysis_notes.quote: They're a team that has a high stunt percentage... they like changing the picture pre-snap to post-snap.

analysis_notes.summary: Joe Burrow aggressively attacks outside the numbers against single-coverage cornerbacks (Cor'Dale Flott and Joshua Williams), isolating Chase and Higgins.
analysis_notes.speaker: Greg Cosell
analysis_notes.quote: He's going to attack the corners... Joe Burrow is as aggressive as any quarterback in the league in attacking outside the numbers when he sees 1-on-1s.

analysis_notes.summary: Tennessee's defensive line failed to generate pressure with four rushers against Cleveland, with star tackle Jeffery Simmons held completely in check.
analysis_notes.speaker: Greg Cosell
analysis_notes.quote: They could not rush the quarterback with their down four... Jeffery Simmons was not a factor really in that game last week.

analysis_notes.summary: When Dallas produces high YPC on first-down runs, Dak Prescott's dropbacks decrease significantly (down to 28), preventing forced passing game situations.
analysis_notes.speaker: Greg Cosell
analysis_notes.quote: Leading into the Eagles game he was averaging 3.5 yards on first down rushing... Dak Prescott was averaging well over 40 dropbacks a game.

analysis_notes.topic: Brian Flores Blitz Scheme & Counter to Play-Action
analysis_notes.summary: Brian Flores blitzes 5+ rushers on 70% of dropbacks from pressure fronts. Defenses increasingly use A/B gap blitzes to blow up under-center play-action passes.
analysis_notes.speaker: Greg Cosell
analysis_notes.quote: They rush five or more on 70% of quarterback dropbacks... teams are attacking through the A and B gaps with pressure and it really impacts the ability to run play action from under center.

analysis_notes.summary: Trevor Lawrence has shown marked improvement throwing between the numbers with precision, anticipation, and pocket toughness behind structured route spacing.
analysis_notes.speaker: Greg Cosell
analysis_notes.quote: That gives Lawrence clean defined reads and he's playing with high-level decisiveness... he has been outstanding working between the numbers.

analysis_notes.summary: Ross and Greg critique Daniel Jones throwing a seam pass directly to Harrison Smith in Cover 2, questioning his pre-snap read and decision-making.
analysis_notes.speaker: Ross Tucker
analysis_notes.quote: I really don't know why Daniel Jones threw that pass... it was first down and he threw it right to Harrison Smith.

analysis_notes.summary: Chiefs added kicker Justin Tucker to their practice squad while Colts receiver Josh Downs requested a trade amidst contract year dynamics.
analysis_notes.speaker: Producer Jack
analysis_notes.quote: Colts wide receiver Josh Downs, he reportedly asked for a trade.

analysis_notes.summary: Texans WR Jaylen Noel underwent season-ending surgery, Chiefs S Derwin James suffered a hamstring setback, and Lions opened S Kirby Joseph's practice window.
analysis_notes.speaker: Producer Jack
analysis_notes.quote: Texans are losing wide receiver Jaylen Noel to a season-ending surgery... Lions opened the practice window for safety Kirby Joseph.
